purpose: Source identities for the canonical machine-oriented firmware repository, its exact OEM snapshots, modified firmware and self-contained server. Historical import identities are retained as provenance rather than current paths.

reorganization_parent.description: Canonical combined project before moving root firmware into the machine-specific modified directory and hub/ into server/.

oem_device_image.description: Verified Pico Pro application image matching the reference used in reconstruction. The private full-flash backup is not imported.

upstream_firmware_archive.treatment: All source files copied unchanged into the corresponding machine-family oem/upstream/ directories, retaining filenames, nesting and Git modes.
upstream_firmware_archive.format_note: The Pico S/Pro and both Pico C files are OEM HTTP update envelopes, preserved without decoding the archived copies. Other upstream binary images are not represented as complete device flash dumps.
upstream_firmware_archive.model_note: Z-series remains a shared archive without inferred Z1/Z2 compatibility. No Zymatic firmware exists in this pinned source tree.

oem_reconstruction.treatment: Exact source snapshot, including its tooling, documentation and earlier decompiler evidence.
oem_reconstruction.description: Buildable OEM reconstruction before v1.x standalone features. Includes documented reconstruction repairs; not original vendor source or a byte-identical OEM rebuild.

modified_firmware.source_component: Firmware files from the previous repository-root layout
modified_firmware.treatment: Current modified firmware component relocated with its on-device website, packages, data, tools, tests and evidence; integration paths updated as needed.

server.treatment: Self-contained Hub application, bundled catalogue, required assets and development/deployment tools; repository integration paths updated.

prior_combined_publication.role: Historical source of completed catalogue/1.1.0 firmware and Hub work recovered before canonical commit 97dd48f. This reference repository is read-only.

earlier_decompiler_export.description: Earlier Pico S/Pro C decompiler-export evidence, distinct from the complete buildable pre-v1.x baseline.

external_zymatic_server_reference.role: Read-only reverse-engineering reference. Existing attributed catalogue artwork retains its source notices.

reference_repository_policy: Read-only. All implementation changes, branches and pull requests belong in the destination repository.
private_data: No API keys, private full-flash backups, Hub databases or build/dependency caches are imported.

web_recovery_candidate.physical_status: Experimental image1 candidate; not installed or physically validated. Current guarded installer and main firmware cannot install or enter it.
